title: Voltage Divider
prompt: A 5 V source drives R1 = 2 Ω and R2 = 2 Ω in series. Find the output voltage across R2, V_out = V_in·R2/(R1 + R2), as an exact fraction.
recap: Two series resistors split the source voltage in proportion: V_out = V_in·R₂/(R₁ + R₂). The larger resistor drops the larger share.
